agent_clauses.clause: Escalates and halts, never guesses, when a change would break an external contract, alter existing stored data, touch the security or authorization model, exceed the stated scope, or need a non-functional budget the brief leaves absent or unquantified

classes.description: An exception to a project invariant or an approved rule, such as a contract rule an Item cannot meet as written.
A change to the Delivery scope, or a grant the work needs that the owner has not given, such as access, a permission or a new external dependency.
Credentials, spending, or an external action that cannot be undone, such as a publication, a deletion or a message to a third party.
